event_name: Document 57 Date 08 September 2019 Time 16:21 2019 ITALIAN GRAND PRIX 5 - 8 September 2019 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Car 23 left the track into turn 5 and gained a lasting advantage.
incident_time: Penalty (1 point awarded, 1 point in total for the 12 month period)
offence: Breach of Article 27.3 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The stewards reviewed video evidence and determined that Car 23 left the track into turn 5 and rejoined gaining a lasting advantage. We note the Race Director advised the team that he would authorise the driver giving back the place however the team declined on the basis that it believed that Car 23 had been forced off the track. Nevertheless, the Stewards believe that the actions of the driver of Car 20 were consistent with the current approach to driving standards ("let them race").
rules_referenced: Article 27.3 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Offence Car 23 Leaving The Track And Gaining An Advantage
